costs.notes: US$0 commission (Questrade US stocks, search summary 2026-10-22). Half-spread: median quoted half-spread in the first minute after the open on six sampled days per stock and year (PREREGISTRATION.md section 5).

risk.notes: Experimental dollar defaults on the simulated US$15,000 (PREREGISTRATION-3.md section 1); not the owner's approved limits.

initialLoss.notes: L0 = effective buy price - 2.5 x the typical daily move at the decision close; never moves; the effective exit level is the higher of L0 and the rule's own level (section 2).
